Ramekin IoT development, deployment, and update platform Ramekin turns a small board (a Raspberry Pi, a mini PC, or similar) into an appliance that runs one app in a container. You build the app on your computer, push it to the device to try it, then publish it to a whole fleet. Every device updates itself safely. Safe updates. A new version must prove it's healthy before it replaces the old one. If it doesn't, the device rolls back on its own. Secure by default. Every image is signed and scanned for known vulnerabilities, and fleet releases are encrypted. Tiny devices. Built on [gokrazy](https://gokrazy.org): no shell or package manager on the device, just your app and one small agent. Simple tooling. Describe your app in an [Apptainer](https://apptainer.org) definition file (a Dockerfile converts in minutes), or build it interactively in a shell. Apptainer is the only container tool you need. Quick start: Hello World Serve a web page from a device with [nginx](https://nginx.org), then change it and push the update. Each build takes a few seconds. Prerequisites on the workstation: Go apptainer [gok](https://gokrazy.org/quickstart/) to flash the device Optionally, [syft](https://github.com/anchore/syft) and [grype](https://github.com/anchore/grype) for CVE scans. Without them, pass noscan to build and push. The examples assume an arm64 board, which is the default platform. For a PC or VM, use ramekin init platform linux/amd64 and device init target amd64. 1\. Install the CLI and create a project. go install github.com/ascensionassociation/ramekin/cmd/ramekin@latest ramekin init helloweb && cd helloweb && rm app.sh ramekin keys generate 2\. Write the page. Create index.html: <doctype html <titleRamekin</title <h1Hello</h1 Replace the generated example.def with this [definition file](https://apptainer.org/docs/user/main/definition%5Ffiles.html). It starts from Chainguard's nginx image, adds the page, and serves it on port 80: A static web page served by nginx, from Chainguard's minimal image, which is rebuilt often to stay free of known vulnerabilities. The dev variant includes the shell ramekind uses to start it. Bootstrap: docker From: cgr.dev/chainguard/nginx:latestdev %files index.html /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html %post Serve on port 80, which Ramekin keeps free by moving gokrazy's dashboard to 8181. cat /etc/nginx/conf.d/nginx.default.conf <<'CONF' server { listen 80; root /usr/share/nginx/html; } CONF 3\. Build. This produces a 23 MiB SIF and scans it. Expect zero findings. ramekin build 4\. Create and flash a development device. ramekin device init hello noupdates healthhttp http://127.0.0.1/ gok i hello overwrite full /dev/sdX use your SD card or disk; this erases it noupdates makes this a dev device: it
items.author: mrbluecoat
items.descZh: Ramekin是一个基于gokrazy构建的物联网（IoT）应用开发、部署与更新平台，旨在将树莓派或迷你PC等小型开发板转化为运行单一容器化应用的专用设备。其核心功能涵盖从本地应用构建、推送到单台设备测试，再到安全发布至整个设备集群的完整生命周期管理。平台在安全性与可靠性方面表现突出，默认提供镜像签名、漏洞扫描和加密传输，并在每次更新前进行健康检查，若新版本异常则设备会自动回滚。在性能与轻量化方面，设备端无操作系统外壳和包管理器，仅保留应用与轻量代理，构建过程仅需几秒即可生成一个大小仅为23 MiB的SIF容器镜像，并能实现零安全漏洞（zero findings）发布。该平台特别适用于需要低资源消耗、高安全性及自动维护的边缘计算场景，如轻量级Web服务托管（如Nginx）和小型设备集群管理。
items.quote: Ramekin 可以将小型板载设备（如树莓派、迷你电脑等）转变为运行单个容器化应用的设备。

items.author: pfehqqq
items.descZh: ViBrow 是一款由个人开发者独立打造的定制化 Python 浏览器，其核心在于完全自研的 viengine 引擎，该引擎从 DOM、CSS 到 JavaScript 均由底层实现，未依赖任何第三方库。该浏览器支持多标签页浏览，并内置了本地缓存、Cookie 管理、搜索功能以及用于绕过网络限制的代理支持。其亮点在于极低的硬件门槛，仅需 700MHz 单核处理器、200MB LPDDR1 内存即可运行，但运行时内存占用会达到 3065MB。它适用于需要在极简或受限环境中运行，同时又要求完整网页渲染能力的场景，例如嵌入式系统或特定自动化任务。
items.quote: ViBrow — кастомный Python браузер с собственным DOM, CSS и JS движками.

No coworkers? No network? Meet people building with AI worldwide. Get matched by interests, level, goals, and chat style for 1:1 chats or groups of four. Your network starts here. No CS degree means no classmates, no alumni and no coworkers. If you taught yourself to code and build things with AI on your own, nobody hands you a network. You just don't have one. Reddit, X and Discord give you comments, not conversations. You ask something, get a few oneline replies from strangers, and never hear from them again. You can't go deep with someone you'll never speak to twice. Neonetworking is built the other way around. Each week you're matched with a few developers building what you're building. You talk in private 1:1 chats or small groups of four. The same people, week after week — you become each other's network. WHAT YOU CAN DO • Talk through what you're stuck on with someone who's been there • Share what you're building and get honest feedback from outside your bubble • Compare notes on tools, pricing, first users, and what AIwritten code does at scale • Find collaborators, from anywhere in the world HOW IT WORKS • Tell us what you're working on: web development, app development, UI/UX design, startup ideas and validation, marketing and growth — and your level in each • Building software? A group opens as soon as one person joins • New suggestions arrive every Monday. Chats you've already started stay open — the weekly reset never closes them • No feed, no followers, nothing to scroll • Something not working, or have an idea? Send feedback from Settings SAFETY AND PRIVACY • For adults only: you must be 18 or older • Report someone or a specific message in a few taps. A person reviews every report • Block anyone, at any time. Rust static file server for directories and individual files. Run it with npx or bunx. No configuration file or Rust toolchain required. [Documentation](https://github.com/skorotkiewicz/dirjet/tree/main/docs) · [Contributing](https://github.com/skorotkiewicz/dirjet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) Why use dirjet? Runs a native binary, downloaded and cached for your OS and CPU. Serves index.html files, directory listings, or a single file with its relative assets. Supports file streaming, MIME types, HEAD requests, byte ranges, and conditional caching. Blocks dotfiles, parent directory traversal, and symlinks that resolve outside the document root. Quick start Requires Node.js 18+ or Bun. Serve a specific directory npx dirjet ./mywebsite Serve a single HTML file npx dirjet index.html Serve the current directory npx dirjet The server listens at http://127.0.0.1:3000 by default. Stop it with Ctrl+C. With Bun, use bunx dirjet ./mywebsite. If Node.js is not installed, use bunx bun dirjet ./mywebsite to run the launcher with Bun. How it serves files Directories Directories serve index.html when present, otherwise they show a directory listing. Directory URLs redirect to a trailing slash so relative assets resolve correctly. Single files Passing a file, such as npx dirjet presentation.html, serves it at / and /presentation.html. Its parent directory becomes the document root so relative stylesheets, scripts, and images work, including assets in subdirectories. Other nonhidden files in that parent directory are also accessible by URL. Directory listings are disabled in singlefile mode. dirjet serves static files. Build TypeScript, JSX, and other frontend source assets before serving them. It does not transpile code, provide live reload, or terminate TLS. Options dirjet [OPTIONS] [PATH] Option Default What it does \p, \port <PORT 3000 Change the server port. Use 0 to automatically pick an available port. \l, \listen <PORT 3000 Alias for \port. \host <IP 127.0.0.1 Bind to a specific IP address. Use 0.0.0.0 to make the server accessible to other devices on your local network. \s, \single Off Singlepage app mode. Serve the entry file for missing extensionless routes. \nolisting Off Returns a 404 Not Found for directories that don't have an index.html file, instead of showing a directory list. \h, \help Show the help menu. \V, \version Show the current version. Serve a singlepage app npx dirjet s ./dist p 8080 Missing routes such as /users/42 return index.html so your frontend router can handle them. Missing assets such as /missing.js still return 404\. When serving a single file, single uses that file as the fallback. Binary downloads and caching On first run, the JavaScript launcher downloads the native binary for your OS and CPU from the matching GitHub release. It verifies the binary's SHA256 checksum before running it and saves it in your OS cache directory. The

[Configuration](configuration) · [Development](development) Huntsman is a small, selfhosted web scraper that turns any page into clean Markdown for LLMs and search. It renders JavaScript with [Lightpanda](https://github.com/lightpandaio/browser), strips ads, trackers and cookie banners, and serves a Firecrawlcompatible /v1/scrape API from one Go binary and one container. No Redis, no Playwright, no Chrome. Why Huntsman Fast and light. On the same 8vCPU machine it scrapes 4× as many pages per second as Firecrawl, and a 2vCPU machine handles 45 pages at once. Clean Markdown. It keeps the main content and drops navigation, footers, ads and cookie banners, using Firecrawl's onlyMainContent rules and the EasyList filters. Dropin API. Requests and responses follow Firecrawl's /v1 shapes, so most clients only need a new base URL. JavaScript when it matters. Lightpanda renders singlepage apps and waits until the page goes quiet. PDFs are fetched directly, and pages that block headless browsers are retried as plain HTML. Batches and crawls. A SQLitebacked queue handles up to 1,000 URLs per batch and wholesite crawls, with a perhost concurrency limit and a result cache. Safe by default. It blocks private, loopback and linklocal addresses at dial time, obeys robots.txt, runs as a nonroot user, and supports a bearer token. items.descZh: Huntsman 是一款轻量级的自托管网页抓取工具，旨在将任意网页高效转化为干净的 Markdown 格式，专为大语言模型（LLM）和搜索引擎应用而设计。它基于 Go 语言开发，利用 Lightpanda 浏览器引擎渲染 JavaScript，并提供与 Firecrawl 完全兼容的 `/v1/scrape` API，无需部署 Redis 或 Playwright 等复杂环境。在性能方面，Huntsman 表现极其出色，在相同的 8vCPU 机器上，其每秒抓取页面数达到 Firecrawl 的 4 倍，且仅需 2vCPU 即可并发处理 45 个页面。此外，该工具支持智能内容提取（过滤广告、横幅和导航），具备每批 1000 个 URL 的队列抓取能力，并内置了内网地址防护和 robots.txt 安全机制。它非常适合用于构建 AI 训练知识库、大规模数据采集以及 SEO 监控等场景。

items.descZh: sendtodot 是一款专注于跨设备共享的开源工具，旨在将手机端的图像及可选的问题无缝注入到用户现有的 "dot" 对话中，同时支持自带服务与自定义授权。核心功能涵盖了 iOS 客户端、Web 桥接、快捷指令及后端附件管理，构建了完整的图片与文本传输通道。技术亮点在于其高度模块化的架构，如负责附件账本管理的 `attachment_ledger.py`、保障通信的 `bridge.mjs`，以及优化图像加载性能的 `fastimageagent` 与解码运行时 `decoder_runtime.mjs`。项目仓库中包含了多模块的丰富测试套件（如 `callback.test.mjs` 和 `attachment_plan_test.py`），确保了核心传输链路的稳定与高可靠性。该工具特别适用于需要将移动端视觉素材快速融入特定 AI 对话、工作流或自动化管道的开发者和高效办公场景。
items.quote: 将手机图像和可选问题分享到您现有的 . 对话中。带上您自己的服务和授权。
